items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: he played with -- Howard played with Dexter, Dexter Gordon group. Howard [Charles] and McPherson

ctx.x: You saw him at the Berlin Festival this year, did you?

Yeah, he played there -- he played with -- Howard played with Dexter, Dexter Gordon group. Howard [Charles] and McPherson -- Stitt was supposed to be there, but Stitt didn't make it. Sonny didn't make it.
Where did you -- it says in here to tour Arizona and New Mexico with Eddie Hill. Did you go to Arizona with his band?
